setup-worktree: . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

. .venv/bin/activate && if [ -f pyproject.toml ] && command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv sync --dev; elif [ -f requirements-dev.txt ] && [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt; elif [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; else echo 'No dependency manifest found (pyproject.toml/requirements*.txt); skipping dependency install.'; fi
. .venv/bin/activate && if [ -f pytest.ini ]; then python -m pytest -q --collect-only; else echo 'pytest.ini not found; skipping pytest collection check.'; fi
